text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornInAmericanCity(x) ::: x is born in an American city.
American(x) ::: x is American.
WrittenBy(y, x) ::: y is written by x.
Author(x, y) ::: x is the author of y.
FamilyHistory(y) ::: y is Family History.
CreatedBy(x, y) ::: x created y.
Year(y, n) ::: y was written in year n.
City(x, y) ::: x is a city y.
Question: Family Secrets is a novel.

Premises:
¬Podcast(FamilySecrets) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornInAmericanCity(x) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, then the person is American.
∀x (Novel(y) ∧ WrittenBy(y, x)) → (Author(x, y) ∧ Novel(y)) ::: If a book is a novel and written by x, then x is a novel writer.
American(DaniShapiro) ∧ Writer(DaniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
WrittenBy(FamilyHistory, DaniShapiro) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
Novel(FamilyHistory) ∧ Year(FamilyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003.
CreatedBy(DaniShapiro, FamilySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created Family Secrets.
City(Boston, American) ::: Boston is an American city.

Conclusion:
Question: FamilySecrets is a novel.
